newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: HERMIS, BIRZAI MOST ACTIVE CM STOCKS LAST WEEK.
newsitem.headline: HERMIS, BIRZAI MOST ACTIVE CM STOCKS LAST WEEK.

text.p: Lithuania's bourse said on Monday that Hermis Bank and Birzai Dairy were the most active stocks on the central market last week.
A spokeswoman for the bourse told Reuters that the turnover of Hermis Bank was 707,700 litas last week while Birzai Dairy registered trade worth 551,062 litas.
The most active stock in bloc trading was electronic components producer Vilniaus Vingis which turned over 2.314 million litas last week, the bourse said.
The biggest price gainers of last week from the A group were Vilniaus Kailiai which rose 3.85 percent and Endokrininiai Preparatai, which increased by 2.94 percent.
The week's losers included Sastatas which fell sharply by 26.88 percent and Krekenavos Agrocompany which saw its price slide by 25.21 percent.
Among the banks Siauliu Bank saw its shares dip by 15 percent last week.
